name: resume-editor
description: Create evidence-based, JD-tailored, importable drafts for the Resume Editor HTML tool.

interface.shortDescription: Tailor evidence-based resumes to target jobs.
interface.longDescription: Resume Editor helps ChatGPT and Codex tailor resumes with evidence-integrity, JD-matching, writing, ATS/one-page, and role-specific guidance. It exposes schema validation, heuristic JD-signal extraction, claim review, and import-payload packaging so users can safely import the result back into the HTML editor.
defaultPrompt: Use $resume-editor to optimize my resume for this JD without inventing facts.
Create a Resume Editor import JSON.
Review my resume claims and one-page risk.
